purpose: Paginated CMS-list grid of blog post cards, on /blog and /blog/archive. Field shape follows the real posts.json record exactly.
measuredFrom: spec/pages/blog/posts.json (492 posts, real field shape); spec/pages/blog-index.md (List > All Blogs)

contentPolicy.note: Card metadata fields ARE measured-real from posts.json. Only the linked post's own long-form BODY is generated placeholder (see sections/content-article-body.json).

author-photo.guidance: COMPLIANCE: authorAvatar fields point to real framerusercontent.com photos of real named authors (e.g. Saniya Sood). Never AI-generate a fabricated likeness of a real person; use the licensed real photo or a generic placeholder avatar for fictional authors only.

card-image.guidance: Editorial illustration/photo for a blog card; safe to AI-generate new, brand-neutral imagery.
